description: The whole row of one Leonida Lab database entry, by the kind and slug that search_database returns: what its page states, its status and the page to cite. A hidden trophy is kind trophy with the slug hidden-<number> (no search lists one) and gives its number, grade and score. An entry that gives part of the story away returns only its flag and its page. Unofficial: Leonida Lab is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

kind.description: The kind of the entry, as search_database gives it.

slug.description: The slug of the entry, as search_database gives it.
